messages:
jason (CS): FYI customer Acme Health (tenant acme-health) reporting repeated SCIM provisioning job failures during SSO import window. They say audit export shows no entries for the tenant for the last 24h and they saw KMS decryption errors in the job logs. Customer is worried about retention/audit compliance.

emma (support): Thanks Jason. Can you paste the provisioning job id, approximate times, and any short log snippets? Any recent SAML attribute mapping changes or SCIM schema updates?

jason (CS): job id = provisioning-job-20260316-9f3b, first failure ~2026-03-16T23:12:45Z, repeated failures until ~23:45. No intentional schema changes reported by customer. Log snippet attached below.

emma (support): paste the snippet here, thx. Also can you confirm whether audit-export job ran for that tenant?

jason (CS): Log snippet:```
2026-03-16T23:12:45Z ERROR provisioning-worker job=provisioning-job-20260316-9f3b scim: POST /Users 500 
error=KMSDecrypt failed: hsm-client: decrypt status=14, err=DECRYPT_ERROR
stack=...
2026-03-16T23:12:46Z WARN provisioning-worker retrying user sync user=jdoe@acmehealth.com attempt=2
2026-03-16T23:12:50Z ERROR audit-export tenant=acme-health export_id=audit-export-20260316-23 entries_written=0
```

deploy-bot: alert: provisioning-job-20260316-9f3b restarted 3x in last hour (:warning:)

raj (eng-security): That KMSDecrypt status=14 looks like a hardware-level decrypt failure from the HSM side (transient or key mismatch). Two immediate asks: 1) grab the KMS request IDs from the provisioning logs (should be next to the KMS call) and 2) confirm whether any key rotations were performed in the last 48h. Also we should restrict the service principal scope while we investigate (least-privilege review).

lina (eng-infra): Can someone run:```
kubectl -n provisioning logs deploy/provisioning-worker --since=3h | grep provisioning-job-20260316-9f3b -A5 -B2
```
and also fetch KMS/HSM gateway logs for that timeframe. For the audit pipeline: check job audit-export-20260316-23 run status (etl-worker logs show 0 entries for tenant). Retention policy is 30d by default but that only matters after we confirm whether entries were generated.

emma (support): Repro plan for customer while we collect logs: 1) run a scoped SCIM sync with 5 test users, 2) enable KMS debug on the provisioning worker env var KMS_DEBUG=true, 3) collect full trace: provisioning + kms_request_id + hsm_response. Example command:```
scim-sync --tenant acme-health --users sample_users.csv --verbose --capture-kms-ids > repro-trace.log 2>&1
```
If they can reproduce, paste the repro-trace.log here.

jason (CS): Customer ran scoped sync and got the same KMSDecrypt error for 2/5 users. They attached repro-trace.log (sending via Slack DM). Also noticed a short billing spike due to retry bursts.

billing-bot: notice: billing alert muted for tenant acme-health while support investigates (requested by emma)

raj (eng-security): If HSM returns transient failures, we should request full HSM audit logs and correlate kms_request_id to HSM trace. Also before any key rotation note: confirm service account IAM/RBAC - it must have only kms:Decrypt for the specific key and not broad key management permissions. Post-incident we should run a least-privilege review on the provisioning principal.

lina (eng-infra): I've queued request to KMS provider for HSM traces (ticket #KMS-4621). Meanwhile I've pulled provisioning-worker logs and see a flurry of KMS errors ~23:12-23:16 and then retries until 23:45 as reported. Audit-export job shows entries_written=0 for that tenant; the export task did run but nothing was persisted because provisioning failed.

emma (support): Next steps documented for CS: 1) collect KMS request IDs and full HSM traces (from provider), 2) confirm whether any key rotation occurred and if so rollback test, 3) run repro with KMS_DEBUG and share logs, 4) perform short RBAC review & restrict service principal scope while investigating, 5) preserve logs for compliance (do not redact until security OKs). I've told customer we'll update within 2 business hours. :thumbsup:

raj (eng-security): Agreed. Also add retention verification to the checklist: confirm audit pipeline didn't drop messages due to schema mismatch and verify export integrity once provisioning succeeds.

emma (support): I'll follow up with the customer after we get HSM traces and repro logs. Escalating to oncall infra (cc @lina).
